item.summary: Union Minister of Commerce & Industry Shri Piyush Goyal today, speaking at the Curtain Raiser of the third edition of Bharat Mobility Global Expo in New Delhi, highlighted the growing stature of the event and the importance of the mobility sector to India's manufacturing and global economic ambitions.
item.title: Bharat Mobility Expo gaining global recognition, third edition to be the second largest such expo in the world: Commerce and Industry Minister Shri Piyush Goyal
